maya: Heads up — noticed a big latency spike on continuous-batcher this morning around 03:21 UTC. p99 jumped from ~120ms to ~860ms for short (<=32) sequences.
chen: Which pool / model? I also saw throughput drop on pool-gpu-2.
maya: model=rdx-small-int8, pool=pool-gpu-2, kernel selector recently landed an update. Selector chose matmul-quantized-v2 for many requests. KV cache miss rate jumped from 12% -> 47% during the window.
ryan: Can you paste the profiler snippet / kernel timings?
maya: logs:
```
[03:20:58] request id=abc123 model=rdx-small-int8 seq=16 microbatch=4 kernel=matmul-quantized-v2 latency=210ms
[03:20:58] request id=abc124 model=rdx-small-int8 seq=16 kernel=matmul-quantized-v2 kv_cache_miss=true kernel_latency=640ms
[03:20:59] admission: dynamic_batcher adjusted batch_size from 8 -> 1 repeatedly (oscillation)
[03:21:02] kv_eviction/sec=2100 node=node-12 cpu_steal=28% kernel_selector_score(mem_pref)=0.92
```
perf-agent: Perf summary (window 03:20-03:25 UTC): p50=40ms p95=220ms p99=860ms. Kernel avg latency mult for seq<32 increased ~6x when matmul-quantized-v2 used. KV eviction rate spiked 450/s -> 2100/s. CPU steal on node-12 correlated with noise.
nina: Did we change admission thresholds yesterday? I merged the dynamic-batcher PR that biases towards larger microbatches (target 64 tokens) for throughput.
chen: That PR also tweaked kernel selector heuristic to prefer quantized kernels when memory footprint lower. Looks like the heuristic misranked quantized kernel for short sequences (latency tradeoff ignored).
maya: Repro steps for debugging: `./tools/loadtest --model rdx-small-int8 --qps 120 --seq 16 --duration 5m` reproduces the p99 jump locally on pool-gpu-2 nodes. Attached flamegraph: https://perf.internal/fg/1811234567 (internal).
ryan: Quick mitigation: pinned kernel to matmul-fp16-v3 on two worst nodes, rolled by hand; p99 dropped back to ~130ms almost immediately.
nina: We should do an emergency cluster-wide pin for affected pools while we fix selector logic. Also limit dynamic batcher max microbatch to 32 for this model to avoid oscillation.
chen: I'll open a PR to: 1) add guard to kernel selector to prefer fp16 for seq<64, 2) add admission cap microbatch<=32 for rdx-small-int8, 3) add a safety threshold that avoids switching kernels more than once per N seconds per model.
ryan: I'll coordinate rollout. Can we do an automated pin rollout and monitor?
maya: Monitoring now — after the manual pin eviction rate dropped: kv_eviction/sec -> 520, p99 -> 140ms. Throughput restored to expected baseline.
infra-bot: deploy started: roll/pin kernel on pool-gpu-2 by ryan @ 1811234690.
ryan: Roll completed across 8 nodes, no errors in rollout logs. Observability shows steady state.
maya: Preliminary root cause: selector heuristic overweighted memory footprint and underestimated wall-time for short sequences. Noisy neighbor (CPU steal) amplified KV eviction thrash which made quantized kernel much slower due to cache misses.
nina: Action items:
- [ ] emergency pin (done)
- [ ] PR for selector guard + admission cap (chen)
- [ ] rollout pin automation + monitor (ryan)
- [ ] add telemetry: per-request kernel-selection_reason, kv_eviction_per_request (nina)
- [ ] unit test for selection heuristic with short-seq benchmarks (chen)
- [ ] postmortem draft (maya)
chen: I'll include microbench results in the PR showing matmul-quantized-v2 tail latency for seq 8/16/32 on noisy nodes.
maya: I'll draft the blameless postmortem and include timeline + graphs + links to PRs.
ryan: Also recommend we add a metric alert for sudden rise in kernel-selection flip-rate (e.g., >5 flips/min per model) and kv_eviction/sec > 500 sustained.
nina: Agreed. Add to runbook for scheduler incidents.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll post the postmortem link here when ready. :thumbsup:
chen: Adding unit test and PR now, pinging reviewers.
maya: Closing this thread for now, will reopen if numbers regress.
